# Panic points remaining in gate code, recorded so `gates-do-not-panic` can ratchet.
#
# A gate that panics prints a backtrace instead of a finding, and stops checking
# the rest of the tree on its way out. An entry here is a debt, not a permission:
# the list only shrinks. Removing a panic point removes its line, and the gate
# fails on a line that is no longer a panic point so the file cannot rot.
#
# Do NOT add a line to silence a failure. A new panic point in a gate is the
# finding.
#
# Canary bodies and infallible `write!`/`writeln!` into a `String` are exempt
# structurally and never appear here.
#
# Format: <path>\t<source line>
